verdict.rationale: Groq's docs describe service tiers (on-demand, flex, auto) and batch processing for shared-pool scaling, but there is no evidence of a dedicated-capacity deployment option with autoscaling that isolates a customer's traffic from the shared serverless pool. A community comment mentions Groq moving to 'call us for quotes' for newer models, hinting at enterprise deals, but this is not documented as a dedicated-GPU-with-autoscaling product feature.
